title: I Shot the Sheriff
hook: The one chord that keeps I Shot the Sheriff *on edge*
cover_text: The chord that keeps it *on edge*

chords.name: Gm7
chords.text: Home: *G minor*. Cool, laid-back, a little dark.

chords.name: Cm7
chords.text: *C minor*, the iv. The mood sinks deeper.

chords.name: Ebmaj7
chords.text: *E♭maj7*: warm and hazy. A moment to breathe.

chords.name: Dm7
chords.text: Minor v: *F, not F♯*. Nothing pulls you home.

chords.name: Gm7
chords.text: Home again, but *never relieved*. Still on edge.
